modal.title: Voices, a smoother ride, and the pull
modal.text: The people who speak now have voices: the two kids at the keyboard in the opening, your friend on the walkie through the radio's crackle, and the last words at the end. The words stay on screen too.
modal.label: The Path v0.8: Voices, a smoother ride, and the pull

modal.title: The town, the delivery, and a fairer fight
modal.text: The dark boxes behind the shops are real buildings now: red brick, painted brick and stucco, full rows of windows with lamps and blinds behind them, shop fronts with awnings, back lanes and parking…
modal.label: The Path v0.7: The town, the delivery, and a fairer fight

modal.title: Relay Tower, clearer skies
modal.text: Relay Tower, clearer skies. The cloud sea sits lower, so there’s open air to swing through under the islands, and diving into the clouds is a soft haze now, not a wall.
modal.label: Signal Arena v0.4.1: Relay Tower, clearer skies

modal.title: The basement, lived in
modal.text: A STARVECTOR poster, a pennant, a note from Mom under the car poster, tapes on the TV, and a bookshelf with role-playing rule books, a dice bag and dice, a little chest and ivy trailing down.
modal.label: The Path v0.6: The basement, lived in

modal.title: Relay Tower, rebuilt
modal.text: Relay Tower, rebuilt. Our first map gets the full treatment: craggy floating islands, real lattice masts, a new dusk sky and sea of clouds.
modal.label: Signal Arena v0.4: Relay Tower, rebuilt

modal.title: The Operator’s Study
modal.text: A new game, and a new map. Shrink to mouse size in an old radio operator’s house: the study, the hallway and the library, with five ways between the bases, behind the bookcases, under the floorboards…
modal.label: Signal Arena v0.3: The Operator’s Study

modal.title: Signal Arena on the studio shelf
modal.text: Signal Arena, our capture-the-flag game, joins our games on the STUDIO shelf. Pick it to visit its page and play.
modal.label: The Junction v1.5: Signal Arena on the studio shelf

modal.title: The controller stays with the duel
modal.text: In The Current's duel, the controller no longer also acts on the world behind it.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04c: The controller stays with the duel
